    Q: France chain: what river runs through Paris, where does it empty, which ocean connects? 法国巴黎塞纳河英吉利海峡大西洋 链条题
    A: France → Paris → Seine river → English Channel (La Manche) → Atlantic Ocean. Paris lies on the Seine; the Seine empties into the English Channel at Le Havre; the Channel's western end opens into the Atlantic. The English Channel is a sea/bay, not a river mouth straight into ocean — treat La Manche as the intermediate sea linking Seine to Atlantic.

    #1381 France-Paris-Seine river chain geography tier=warm conf=0.85 lesson= when= tokens=6
    Q: What river flows through Paris, what sea does the Seine empty into, and what ocean connects?
    A: Paris lies on the Seine River; the Seine empties into the English Channel (La Manche); the English Channel connects to the Atlantic Ocean. Chain: France → Paris → Seine → English Channel → Atlantic Ocean. Note: the Seine meets the Channel via its estuary at Le Havre/Honfleur; the Channel (La Manche) links to the Atlantic at its western end past the Strait of Dover (Pas de Calais connects it to the North Sea in the east).

    keywords: 法国, Paris, Seine, 塞纳河, English Channel, 英吉利海峡, La Manche, Atlantic Ocean, 大西洋, capital river sea ocean chain

    #1172 gopi 三段式分支收编链（发现/试探/分流）实现配方 tier=warm conf=1.00 lesson= when= sources=feat/branch-adoption-chain @ 0c183cc,~/workspace/gopi-adoption-chain tokens=1 fb=0.85(5)
    Q: gopi serve tick 怎么自动收编 client push back 的分支？merge 冲突自动派解冲突任务的实现配方与坑？
    A: 三段式分支收编链（branch adoption chain）实现配方：①发现=git for-each-ref 双通道 refs/heads+refs/remotes（本地路径 remote 的 git push 直达 refs/heads 不产生 remote-tracking ref！调试时被坑）+台账 completed 任务 deliverable.branch 配对门（孤儿分支 skip）②试探=git merge --no-commit --no-ff（TryMerge seam）③a 干净=commit "adoption: merge <branch> (<tip>)"+branch [-r] -d；③b 冲突=merge --abort 保存现场+TaskSubmit 自足 briefing（冲突文件 --diff-filter=U、逐文件 <<<<<<< 块 40 行截断、master...branch --stat、台账 intent、验收标准），tags=merge-conflict,auto-dispatch 经 taskTagPriority 自动高优先 ④红线=Go 只做发现/试探/派发/收编 ⑤防风暴=payload-keyed 查重（payload LIKE '%branch <name> (tip %'）且查重在试探之前跑。serve 集成=serveAdoptionSweep() pass step（serveStaleSweep 之后），GOPI_ADOPTION_INTERVAL 默认 15min 0/负/junk=禁用，脏工作树拒绝。CLI=gopi task adopt [--repo --master --submit] 默认 report-only。坑：TaskUpdate 状态机 pending→completed 非法须过 in_progress；TaskSearch 只搜 summary+FTS 不含 payload（查 payload 要直开 DB SELECT）；CLI 子命令加 verb 三处=parseTasksArgs case+taskFlagMember case+runTasksSubcommand switch；cmd/agent 包名是 main 不是 agent。master 基线 be60518 上 go test ./internal/tools/ 全量 hang 超时（sql connectionOpener，master 既有）——验证用 -run 相关族。

    keywords: 分支收编 branch adoption chain, 收编链, merge 自动收编 auto-merge branch, serve tick pass step, serveAdoptionSweep, GOPI_ADOPTION_INTERVAL 节流, refs/heads 直达 push 本地路径 remote, for-each-ref 双通道, remote-tracking ref 不产生, 冲突派任务 conflict dispatch briefing, merge-conflict tag 高优先, taskTagPriority, payload 查重 dedup 同分支一次, 幂等 re-tick, TaskSearch 不搜 payload, TaskUpdate 状态机 in_progress 中转, cli_tasks verb 三处注册, task_adoption.go, devdoc/branch-adoption-chain.md, feat/branch-adoption-chain

    #1347 Manual task-run worktree recycle — three root causes + fix tier=warm conf=0.95 lesson= when= eff_conf=1.00 sources=GoPi epic t-1788397248,commit 319f063 tokens=1 fb=0.75(2)
    Q: Why did a manual gopi task run leave its worktree behind (and how was it fixed)? What were the three root causes?
    A: Root cause of 'manual gopi task run leaves its worktree behind' (epic t-1788397248) and the fix, for reuse: (1) The finish-cleanup chain TaskFinishCleanupSessionID was client-gated — `if IsServerNode() { skip }` returned before ANY worktree removal, so server/single-node (peerbox has no sync_peers) NEVER recycled. Fix: mode-split — IsServerNode() OR finishCleanupServerTarget()=="" (no peers) → new finishCleanupServerRecycle (worktree remove only, KEEP branch = merger input); client-with-peer → the existing push→remove→-d chain unchanged. (2) git worktree list --porcelain is MULTI-LINE — the chain's finishCleanupGit first-line summarizer truncated it, so the porcelain parsers (finishCleanupBranchWorktree, finishCleanupOwningWorktree) silently never matched a linked worktree. Fix: finishCleanupGitRaw raw-output reader; also the FIRST porcelain entry is the main checkout — never return it (skip on first). (3) The child's own end-hook chain runs on its AUTO row (no deliverable → skip); the WRAPPER row carries deliverable{repo,branch} but was closed by writeback with no chain call. Fix: delivery-time hook in runTaskRunOnce after completed writeback + mirror reconcile — the shared funnel for manual task run / task run next / worker round, so all recycle at delivery. Server arm guards: exempt branch (master etc), clean worktree (git status --porcelain — dirty = live bond skip), linked-worktree-on-branch resolution. File: internal/tools/task_finish_cleanup.go; devdoc/manual-taskrun-recycle-20260903.md.

    keywords: manual task run worktree left behind, finish-cleanup client-gated, IsServerNode skip, server single-node never recycled, finishCleanupServerRecycle, worktree list porcelain multi-line truncation, first-line summarizer bug, finishCleanupGitRaw, wrapper row no chain call, runTaskRunOnce delivery-time hook, task run next worker round share funnel, worktree remove keep branch merger input, 分支保留合并输入, 工作树未回收根因

    #224 CivRealm evidence: LLM agents vs heuristic AI in turn-based 4X games tier=warm conf=0.85 lesson= when= eff_conf=1.00 sources=arXiv:2401.10568 (CivRealm); arXiv:2305.16291 (Voyager); arXiv:2303.11366 (Reflexion) tokens=1
    Q: How well do LLM agents (GPT-4) perform playing Civilization VI via a text interface, and what are their failure modes?
    A: CivRealm (Meta FAIR, arXiv:2401.10568) built a text-based interface to Civilization VI and evaluated GPT-4 / ReAct-style agents against the game's heuristic AI. Results: LLM agents LOST DECISIVELY (often 2-3x score gap) despite perfect symbolic state. Three failure modes, in order: (1) long-term planning / temporal credit assignment — agent abandoned its own 50-turn-old goals because each prompt was fresh context; (2) resource/economy management — spammed unpayable units, misordered build queues, settled cities on bad tiles; (3) spatial reasoning — textual grid caused circular movement, ignored river defense bonuses, failed adjacency rules. Transferable lesson for any LLM-in-4X project (HoMM3/VCMI included): the bottleneck is cognition not perception; mitigate with persistent plan memory + reflection (Reflexion), skill libraries (Voyager), and engine-computed tools for pathfinding/danger instead of raw grids. Also: a non-vision LLM CAN drive a GUI 4X game through a text bridge — the modality is not the blocker.

    keywords: CivRealm Civ VI LLM agent benchmark, GPT-4 lose strategy game heuristic AI, LLM 4X game failure long-term planning spatial, text interface turn-based strategy LLM, Voyager skill library Reflexion reflection game, LLM agent cognition not perception bottleneck
